_meta.description: Falconer subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: double attack (falcon), bleed/DoT, evasion.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la chance de double attaque de 0.8% et l'ATK de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases double attack chance by 0.8% and ATK by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats de 1.2% et la chance d'appliquer des effets de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage by 1.2% and effect chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'esquive de 1% et la vitesse d'attaque de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases evasion by 1% and attack speed by 0.5% per level.
